action.command:
cd /workspace && su - ddevuser -c 'cd /workspace && ddev setup-docu-data 2>&1' | tail -5
WEBIP=$(docker inspect -f '{{(index .NetworkSettings.Networks "ddev-tfm-fachplanung_default").IPAddress}}' ddev-tfm-fachplanung-web)
docker run --rm --user 1000:1000 -v /workspace:/e2e -w /e2e \
  --network ddev-tfm-fachplanung_default --add-host web:$WEBIP \
  -e CYPRESS_baseUrl=http://web \
  -e CYPRESS_user_r1=r1_user -e CYPRESS_pass_r1=r1_password \
  -e CYPRESS_user_r2=r2_user -e CYPRESS_pass_r2=r2_password \
  cypress/included:13.17.0 run --spec "cypress/e2e/02-benutzerverwaltung.cy.js" 2>&1 | grep -E "passing|failing|✖|Tests:|Passing:|Failing:" | tail -15; echo "EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && su - ddevuser -c 'cd /workspace && ddev setup-docu-data 2>&1' | tail -5\nWEBIP=$(docker inspect -f '{{(index .NetworkSettings.Networks \"ddev-tfm-fachplanung_default\").IPAddress}}' ddev-tfm-fachplanung-web)\ndocker run --rm --user 1000:1000 -v /workspace:/e2e -w /e2e \\\n  --network ddev-tfm-fachplanung_default --add-host web:$WEBIP \\\n  -e CYPRESS_baseUrl=http://web \\\n  -e CYPRESS_user_r1=r1_user -e CYPRESS_pass_r1=r1_password \\\n  -e CYPRESS_user_r2=r2_user -e CYPRESS_pass_r2=r2_password \\\n  cypress/included:13.17.0 run --spec \"cypress/e2e/02-benutzerverwaltung.cy.js\" 2>&1 | grep -E \"passing|failing|\u2716|Tests:|Passing:|Failing:\" | tail -15; echo \"EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}\"", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Rerun benutzerverwaltung with aligned LDAP"}
